plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.Ce terminal donne un accès root à la mac: This terminal gives root access to the machine.
plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.Sur une installation Jeedom, le compte w: On a Jeedom installation, the www-data account can use sudo without a password: even opened as www-data, the shell can do anything, including making Jeedom or the system unusable. Only Jeedom administrators can open the terminal; give that profile to trusted people only.
plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.Le shell tourne dans une session tmux qu: The shell runs inside a tmux session that survives closing the tab: it is found as it was when reopened, long-running commands included. All windows then share the same session. tmux is installed with the dependencies.
plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.À l'ouverture, une bannière résume la ma: On opening, a banner sums up the machine (system, Jeedom version, memory, disk, IP address). The prompt is in colour and shows the error code of the last command, and shortcuts are added: jlog (follow a log), jcd (plugin folder), jerr, jplugins, jinfo, jrestart; jhelp lists them. The account's ~/.bashrc is still read. For an account whose shell is not bash, nothing changes.
plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.Refuse d'ouvrir un terminal depuis l'ext: Refuses to open a terminal from outside (remote access, Jeedom DNS, reverse proxy). This is a convenience filter, not an absolute protection: the client address is derived from HTTP headers. Applied immediately, without a restart.
plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.Port sur lequel le démon écoute, sur 127: Port the daemon listens on, on 127.0.0.1 only; Apache relays the terminal to it. Change it only if it is already taken, then run the dependency installation again.
plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.Les réglages du démon sont appliqués à s: Daemon settings are applied when it restarts: if one of them changes, saving restarts the daemon in the background, which closes all open terminals (a tmux session survives). Changing the port also requires running the dependency installation again, which rewrites the Apache configuration.
plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.www-data est le compte sous lequel tourn: www-data is the account Jeedom runs as. root and other accounts go through sudo; an account that does not exist, or whose shell is disabled (nologin), is refused when saving.
plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.Un terminal sans aucune frappe au clavie: A terminal without any keystroke for this long is closed. A command that keeps printing does not count as activity. 0 disables closing; 10080 (one week) at most.
plugins/jeeterm/plugin_info/configuratio.Nombre maximal de terminaux ouverts en m: Maximum number of terminals open at the same time, all administrators combined (1 to 20).
